findings: The SELECT 1 correlated EXISTS seed is valid.
The revision-3 F01 result failed before binding because the replacement alias innerB was treated as clause-like; renamedB is an ordinary identifier and leaves stale b.Country as the sole fault.
The revision-3 F02 result must replace both the outer projection and source declaration with renamedA so only correlated inner a.Country remains stale.
The resulting candidates each have one MQ3015_UnknownAlias at the intended nested scope.
